svg.title: The Fisher ellipse, and a blind direction
svg.desc: Left: 1500 maximum-likelihood estimates of (μ, σ) for a normal with μ = 1 and σ = 2, each from 50 draws, inside the two-standard-deviation ellipse predicted by the inverse Fisher matrix divided by N. Right: for a logistic model whose logit is a·b·x, every (a, b) on the curve ab = 1.2 gives the same predictions, and the Fisher matrix at (1.5, 0.8) is singular along the curve's tangent: the data cannot see that direction.
svg.text: every (a, b) on the curve ab = 1.2 makes the same predictions
